Compile an HPC-Ready Apptainer / Singularity Definition File

Source: R/compile_apptainer.R
compile_apptainer.Rd

Generates an Apptainer/Singularity .def recipe from an rcapsule_scan (or project directory path) suitable for university and national HPC clusters. Includes pinned Bootstrap: docker / From: headers, %labels, %files, %environment, strict set -euo pipefail %post provisioning for OS system libraries, scientific toolchains, and R packages, standard HPC bind mount points, %runscript, and a %test verification suite.

Usage

compile_apptainer(
  scan,
  output = NULL,
  base_image = NULL,
  r_version = NULL,
  base_digest = NULL,
  cran_repo = "https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/2026-01-15",
  quarto_version = "1.5.57",
  cmdstan_version = "2.35.0",
  workdir = "/capsule",
  entrypoint = NULL,
  allow_unpinned = FALSE
)

Arguments

scan

An rcapsule_scan object from scan_project() or a path to a project directory.

output

Optional file path to write the .def recipe (e.g., "Apptainer.def"). If NULL, returns the compiled spec in memory.

base_image

Optional pinned Docker base image (defaults to paste0("rocker/r-ver:", r_version)).

r_version

Optional R version string overriding scan$r_version.

base_digest

Optional SHA-256 image digest appended to base_image.

cran_repo

Pinned CRAN or Posit Public Package Manager repository URL.

quarto_version

Pinned Quarto CLI version when Quarto is detected.

cmdstan_version

Pinned CmdStan version when CmdStan is detected.

workdir

Project directory inside the container image. Defaults to "/capsule".

entrypoint

Optional override for the %runscript entrypoint.

allow_unpinned

Logical; if FALSE (default), rejects :latest or untagged base images.

Value

An S3 object of class c("rcapsule_apptainer", "rcapsule_spec") with fields content, lines, base_image, r_version, sections, project_type, path, def_path, sif_path, binds, def_sha256, content_digest, and scan.

Examples

tmp <- tempfile("rcapsule_apptainer_")
dir.create(tmp)
writeLines(c("library(stats)", "cat(mean(1:10), '\\n')"), file.path(tmp, "run.R"))
def <- compile_apptainer(tmp)
cat(def$content)
#> # Generated by rcapsule 0.5.1
#> # Project: rcapsule_apptainer_19a97627f3a9 (analysis) | R 4.6.2
#> Bootstrap: docker
#> From: rocker/r-ver:4.6.2
#> 
#> %labels
#>     Project rcapsule_apptainer_19a97627f3a9
#>     ProjectType analysis
#>     RVersion 4.6.2
#>     GitRevision uncommitted
#>     CreatedBy rcapsule-0.5.1
#> 
#> %files
#>     . /capsule
#> 
#> %environment
#>     export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
#>     export LANG=C.UTF-8
#>     export TZ=UTC
#>     export CAPSULE_DIR=/capsule
#> 
#> %post
#>     set -euo pipefail
#>     export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
#>     export TZ=UTC
#>     export R_REPOS=https://packagemanager.posit.co/cran/2026-01-15
#> 
#>     # OS system dependencies
#>     apt-get update \
#>     && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
#>       ca-certificates \
#>     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
#> 
#>     cd /capsule
#> 
#>     # HPC compatibility: create standard bind mount points & non-root read permissions
#>     mkdir -p /scratch /work /data
#>     chmod -R a+rX /capsule
#> 
#> %runscript
#>     cd /capsule
#>     exec Rscript "run.R" "$@"
#> 
#> %test
#>     set -euo pipefail
#>     R --version
unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
